30-Eval Rotation Batches · 2020–2026

Each batch has 30 evaluations of 50K: end-of-day trailing $2,000, pass at +$3,000 over at least 2 days, best day ≤ 50%. A batch ends when every account has passed or blown, and the next batch starts the next session. The accounts take turns through the day, one trade each per day: +$1,500 (limit) or down to the −$2,000 floor. The first trade of a batch is BUY BUY (or SELL SELL). After a blow-up the next account keeps the same side; after a win it either CONTINUES that side or ALTERNATES. RANDOM is the control. Data: real 1-minute MNQ and MGC closes, $1 a contract round trip plus 1 tick of slippage each side, $120 per eval.
